title: Ghost fingerprick calibration values entered.
symptom: Users report ghost fingerstick calibration values appearing in xDrip+ that they did not enter, often hours after a real reading, and these phantom values are used for calibration, skewing the calibration curve and causing incorrect glucose readings.
cause: The issue is caused by the automatic calibration feature, specifically the setting 'Use Treatment BG values' set to 'Automatic', which queues fingerstick readings entered via the Treatments dialog and processes them later, applying them to the current sensor reading instead of the past one.
fix: Disable automatic calibration (turn off auto-calibration or set 'Use Treatment BG values' to 'never use them') to stop ghost calibrations from occurring.
settings_changed: Use Treatment BG values → Automatic (was set to this, causing issue)
evidence_quote: Right after I reported this issue, I switched auto-calibration off, and can confirm that stops it from occurring.
